items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Andy Kirk said he met me years ago in Dalls when we did a concert. Well, I didn't remember that.

ctx.x: DID YOU MET HIM AROUND THAT TIME?

No, I don't remember meeting him. I don't think I knew him until later. You see that band was so outstanding that a lot of the guys who knew me, had been guys who played in the band. Andy Kirk said he met me years ago in Dalls when we did a concert. Well, I didn't remember that.
HE WASN'T ANYBODY AT THAT TIME.
